legal_units.text: A penalty of Rs. 25000 may be imposed on a person by the Assessing Officer or the Joint Commissioner (Appeals) or the Commissioner (Appeals), if he fails to—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 441 Failure to keep, maintain or retain books of account, documents, etc. A penalty of Rs. 25000 may be imposed on a person by the Assessing Officer or the Joint Commissioner (Appeals) or the Commissioner (Appeals), if he fails to—

legal_units.title: Failure to keep, maintain or retain books of account, documents, etc.
legal_units.text: keep and maintain the books of account and other documents as per section 62 or the rules made thereunder, in respect of any tax year; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 441 Failure to keep, maintain or retain books of account, documents, etc. A penalty of Rs. 25000 may be imposed on a person by the Assessing Officer or the Joint Commissioner (Appeals) or the Commissioner (Appeals), if he fails to— Section 441(a): keep and maintain the books of account and other documents as per section 62 or the rules made thereunder, in respect of any tax year; or

legal_units.title: Failure to keep, maintain or retain books of account, documents, etc.
legal_units.text: retain such books of account and other documents for the period specified in the said rules.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 441 Failure to keep, maintain or retain books of account, documents, etc. A penalty of Rs. 25000 may be imposed on a person by the Assessing Officer or the Joint Commissioner (Appeals) or the Commissioner (Appeals), if he fails to— Section 441(b): retain such books of account and other documents for the period specified in the said rules.
